svg.aria-label: Homelabrrr: Self-service portal for a Proxmox homelab with FortiGate-backed networking. Users get assigned VMs and LXCs with browser VNC, SSH and SFTP; admins manage hosts, VLANs, firewall policies, port forwards and audit history from one place.
